## 👨‍💻 About me

I'm a **Senior Full Stack Web Developer** with **7+ years** of experience building SaaS, B2B, travel, e-commerce, recruitment and AI-enabled web applications with **Laravel, PHP, Vue.js and Nuxt**.

I like turning business requirements into clean database structures, APIs and working features, and I care a lot about **performance**: I've taken workflows that took **30–60 seconds down to milliseconds** by fixing queries, adding indexes, caching and moving heavy work to queues.

- 🔭 Currently: **Senior Full Stack Web Developer** at [IdeaTechOne](https://ideatechone.com) (Islamabad)
- 🤖 Lately: AI features with **OpenAI, LLMs and RAG** inside Laravel apps
- ☁️ Shipping on **AWS (EC2, RDS, S3), Docker, Nginx and GitHub Actions**
- 🧑‍🏫 Code reviews, breaking big features into tasks, and helping teammates get unblocked
- 🌍 Languages: Pashto (native), Urdu, English
- 📫 [hussainali9616@gmail.com](mailto:hussainali9616@gmail.com) · 🌐 [hussainali.me](https://hussainali.me)
